question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Neck of the woods
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e.** 'Neighbourhood'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"neck of the woods"** refers to a specific area or neighborhood, typically the one a person is located in or is talking about.
 
• **"Neighbourhood" **- This is the correct choice. A neighborhood is a district or community within a town or city.
 
• **It aligns** with the meaning of the idiom "neck of the woods" which is often used to mean a certain area or location, typically one's local area.(पड़ोस)

Therefore, the **correct answe**r is:** 'Neighbourhood'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Barren land" **- Barren land refers to land that is too poor to produce much or any vegetation, a place that's unproductive. (बंजर भूमि).
 
• **"Valley"** - A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it. (घाटी).
 
• **"Highways"** - Highways are main roads, especially one connecting major towns or cities. (राजमार्ग).
